title: Rename urn:jmap: to urn:ietf:params:jmap: corpus-wide
description: Mark 2026-10-20: urn:jmap: was a mistake; use RFC 8620 sec 9.3 sub-namespace urn:ietf:params:jmap: everywhere. Mechanical sed plus rewrite of convention/namespace prose (chat-00 iana-urn section, calendars object URN + collision rule, filenode/graph URN convention paragraphs). Collision rule must now cover core capabilities (e.g. filenode).
notes:
Done: sed (428), namespace prose rewrites, chat:cap: placeholder registration (RFC 8620 9.4.7 model; also covers error: segment), ABNF scoped to corpus-assigned names, calendars/tasks 'registered by' fixed, 21 long using-array lines rewrapped; all drafts build with baseline warning counts. OPEN DECISION (Mark): object URNs urn:ietf:params:jmap:<type>:<acct>:<id> violate RFC 3553 (global scope, IANA-assigned, unique). Options: (b) only type prefix assigned, full string is context-relative reference; (a) stop calling them URNs / move out of urn:ietf:params. Affects chat-00 iana-urn item 2 + Uniqueness, calendars object-urn + iana-urn-types (also needs RFC 3553 reference request), tasks urn:...:task, graph-projection objectUrn.
Mark chose (c): dedicated URI scheme jmap: for object references (jmap:<type>:<acct>:<id>); term object URN -> object URI; registry JMAP Object URI Types; drop collision rule + RFC 3553 requests.
Mark: (1) yes move jmap: scheme + JMAP Object URI Types registry to standalone draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00; (2) filenode role value -> plain token 'chatspace'.
close_reason: urn:ietf:params:jmap: rename done; object refs moved to jmap: URI scheme in standalone draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00; chat:cap: placeholder; chatspace role; 3 verify workflows applied. Follow-ups: draj, b9qs.
